cohort: Women who had one pregnancy following ovulation induction and one unassisted pregnancy
finding: Pregnancies following ovulation induction treatments are associated with lower birth weight.
mod_finding: Pregnancies following ovulation induction treatments are associated with lower birth weight, but the rate of preterm birth is not significantly different from unassisted pregnancies.
birth_weight: Birth weight was significantly lower in ovulation induction pregnancies (3,167 ± 436 vs. 3,251 ± 460 g, p = 0.009)
